about: Páginas de comunidad que genera .github/scripts/render-site.py con hub.html y area.html. giscus es la única configuración de los comentarios: los IDs salen de la API GraphQL de GitHub (repository.id y discussionCategories) o de https://giscus.app. Con repoId o categoryId vacíos, las páginas muestran un enlace a GitHub en lugar del widget.

en.title: Community
en.description: Ideas, feedback, problems and questions about Rowly DB. Each area has a conversation you join with your GitHub account.
en.lede: Each area has a conversation on this site. You comment with your GitHub account.

channels.title: Comment in an area on this site
channels.text: Short ideas, impressions and questions, in the conversation of each area below.

channels.title: Start a topic in GitHub Discussions
channels.text: When a proposal or a question needs its own thread.

channels.title: Report a reproducible bug in GitHub Issues
channels.text: With the steps, the version and your system, so it can be fixed.

en.notSupport: This is a community space, not a support service. The maintainer and other users answer when they can.
en.fallback: Comments for this area live in GitHub Discussions.
en.images: To attach a screenshot, open this conversation on GitHub
en.warn: Do not paste passwords, connection strings or private data. Security problems are not reported here.
